businessFull: Bliss in the Park — South Park Gardens, Wimbledon
headline: Bliss in the Park - we made you a website.
note: Phoebe and I found your Friday nights on Facebook - Mauritian food, live music, the bar in the park - but there’s no website behind it. So we built you one, free, from your own posts, menus and photos.

Everything lives on Facebook right now, so people who don’t use it never find you, and every order comes back through WhatsApp by hand. A site puts the Friday menu, the dates and the pre-orders in one link - and gets you found on Google when someone searches “food and live music in Wimbledon”.
Scan the code to see it. Love it? It’s £30 a month to keep, cancel anytime.
